headline: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
context: NAZA is an acronym for nezek agavi , Hebrew for "collateral damage." It refers to the number of civilian casualties the Israeli military deems acceptable. The documentary is made by Israeli filmmakers.
